lead.tldr: Illicit stablecoin flows hit $141B in 2025, led by sanctions evasion, raising compliance risks for investors. • Superstate secures $82.5M to expand tokenized equities, signaling institutional tokenization acceleration. • Optimism token drops 25% after Coinbase Base forks OP Stack, threatening Superchain revenue streams. • CME launches 24/7 crypto futures trading May 29, targeting surging derivatives volumes for traders. • Blockfills seeks buyer after $75M loss and withdrawal halt, highlighting DeFi lending vulnerabilities. • Bitcoin Lightning Network exceeds $1B monthly volume, confirming scaling solution adoption growth.

top_signals.title: Illicit Stablecoin Activity Hit a Five-Year High in 2025
top_signals.summary: Illicit stablecoin activity reached a five-year high in 2025, with wallets linked to illicit entities receiving $141 billion, primarily driven by sanctions evasion networks that accounted for 86% of all illicit crypto flows. Roughly half of this volume, or $72 billion, involved the Russian ruble-pegged A7A5 token, which connects sanctioned actors from Russia, China, Iran, North Korea, and Venezuela, enabling large-scale value movement outside traditional financial controls. For institutional investors, this underscores stablecoins' dual role as core infrastructure for legitimate treasury operations and remittances, exceeding $1 trillion in monthly volumes, while representing just 1% of total flows amid rising compliance risks from concentrated sanctions exposure. TRM Labs emphasizes that 99% of stablecoin activity remains licit, but enhanced monitoring of high-risk networks is critical for risk management.

top_signals.title: Superstate Raises $82.5M to Scale Onchain Equity Issuance
top_signals.summary: Superstate raised $82.5M in a Series B round led by Bain Capital Crypto. The funding will be used to expand Superstate's services from tokenized Treasuries to SEC-registered equity issuance onchain.

top_signals.title: Optimism token price plunges 25% as Coinbase cuts off DAO from millions in revenue
top_signals.summary: Coinbase's Base will switch to in-house code instead of Optimism's OP Stack, causing the Optimism token price to plunge 25%. This move impacts the Superchain, a collection of blockchains including Sony's Soneium, Uniswap's Unichain, and Kraken's Ink, and will negatively affect Optimism's onchain revenues.

top_signals.title: Tennessee judge grants preliminary injunction blocking state enforcement against Kalshi
top_signals.summary: A Tennessee judge granted a preliminary injunction blocking state enforcement against Kalshi, a prediction market platform. The judge ruled that Kalshi's sports event contracts qualify as 'swaps' under federal commodities regulations, thus preempting state laws.

top_signals.title: CME Group to launch 24/7 crypto futures and options trading on May 29
top_signals.summary: CME Group is launching 24/7 cryptocurrency futures and options trading on May 29. This move aims to capitalize on record high trading volumes in the crypto derivatives market.

top_signals.title: Has Strategy Defused the Global Game?
top_signals.summary: Strategy raised $2.25 billion in cash reserves to cover preferred dividends. The article questions whether this move has resolved a larger issue or simply postponed it.

top_signals.title: Crypto Lender Blockfills Seeks Sale to Plug $75M Loss: CoinDesk
top_signals.summary: Crypto lender Blockfills is reportedly seeking a buyer after suspending withdrawals and deposits due to a $75 million loss. The Susquehanna-backed company is facing financial difficulties and exploring a sale as a potential solution.

top_signals.title: Crypto, Banks Meet Again to Move Forward Crypto Bill
top_signals.summary: Executives from Coinbase and Ripple met with banking lobbyists at the White House to discuss stablecoin rewards and a crypto market structure bill. The talks aim to move forward the stalled crypto bill.

top_signals.title: ‘Higher for longer’: Can Bitcoin survive Fed’s latest $18.5B liquidity injection?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the potential impact of the Federal Reserve's $18.5 billion liquidity injection on Bitcoin, particularly in the context of fading rate cut expectations. It suggests that Bitcoin's performance is being affected by these macroeconomic factors and intensifying fear narratives.

top_signals.title: BTC Lightning Network Tops $1B in Monthly Transaction Volume: River
top_signals.summary: River's analysis indicates that the Bitcoin Lightning Network's transaction volume exceeded $1 billion in November 2025. This milestone suggests growing adoption and usage of the Lightning Network for Bitcoin transactions.

top_signals.title: Kraken xStocks Surpasses $25B in Tokenized Stock Volume
top_signals.summary: Kraken's xStocks platform, which deals with tokenized equities, has surpassed $25 billion in transaction volume. The increase in onchain holders suggests growing demand for tokenized stocks.

top_signals.title: All about Ethereum’s derivatives reset as exchange reserves hit multi-year lows
top_signals.summary: The article discusses Ethereum's on-chain data and its current price action, highlighting an interesting inflection point. It also mentions exchange reserves hitting multi-year lows.
